Early Access Game

Get instant access and start playing; get involved with this game as it develops.

Note: Games in Early Access are not complete and may or may not change further. If you are not excited to play this game in its current state, then you should wait to see if the game progresses further in development. Learn more

What the developers have to say:

Why Early Access?

“Through Early Access, I want to hear directly from you about what content and features you want, and grow the game together accordingly. As a solo developer, I consider real player reactions and feedback very important in determining the direction of development. Your feedback during this period will be a great help in developing a better game.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

“The Early Access period is expected to last roughly 6 months to 1 year. The actual duration may vary depending on development progress and community feedback.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

“In the full version, content and features requested by the community during the Early Access period will be added, allowing you to enjoy more diverse and richer gameplay than what is currently available. Reported issues will also be fixed, and overall game stability will be improved. Specific details may vary depending on community feedback and development progress.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

“The current Early Access version includes the core features needed to run a PC cafe. Purchasing desks and PC equipment, ordering and receiving supplies, cooking and serving food, expanding store space, and customer and employee AI systems are all functional. The game supports single-player as well as co-op multiplayer. You can experience the basic PC cafe management gameplay cycle from start to finish, and more content and features will be added during the Early Access period based on community feedback.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

“The price is expected to increase at full release as new content and features are added. Purchasing during the Early Access period allows you to enjoy the game at a more affordable price.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

“I plan to communicate frequently with players in the Steam Community Hub. All feedback including bug reports, feature suggestions, and content ideas is welcome, and your opinions will be actively incorporated into development. Update news and development progress will also be shared through this channel.”

About This Game

Build, run, and grow your very own PC cafe.

PC Cafe Simulator is a management simulation game set in a Korean PC cafe—an internet cafe built for PC gaming. Become the owner of a PC cafe and grow it from a small shop into a popular place filled with customers. Play solo at your own pace, or team up with friends in co-op multiplayer for up to 8 players.

Build Your Own PC Cafe

Purchase the furniture and equipment you need to run your PC cafe and decorate it your way.

Use customization features to create an interior with the atmosphere you want.

Cook and Serve a Variety of Food

No Korean PC cafe is complete without food! Cook the food your customers order and serve it to them yourself. Keep your customers satisfied with delicious meals and increase your sales.

Order Supplies and Manage Your Inventory

Order the supplies you need for your PC cafe and receive deliveries.

Manage the inventory needed to keep your store running. Stock up on the food your customers want and run your store efficiently.

Realistic Customers and Staff

Customers will visit your PC cafe, sit down, play games, order food, and leave reviews based on their experience.

If there are no customers, head outside and attract passersby to bring more people into your PC cafe.

Rain or Shine

The sun rises and sets as time passes, and the weather changes from day to day.

Deal With Troublemakers Yourself

Some customers may run away without paying or cause a scene. Deal with them yourself using a broom!

Play Alone or With Friends

Run your PC cafe at your own pace in single-player, or split up roles with friends in co-op multiplayer for up to 8 players and manage the store more efficiently.

When you need a break, relax by listening to music or watching videos. You can enjoy them while working in your store too!

After closing time, buy fireworks and enjoy a fireworks show with your friends!

Create fun moments using a variety of emotes!

If one of your lazy friends is not doing their job, teach them a lesson with your broom!
